synthesize_local_speech: Generate one short speech passage with the installed TTS voice. Split long narration at sentence boundaries into about 320-character passages, each with a distinct passageId; do not put a whole guide into one take. Join successful clips with export_narration or export_media_composition. From get_local_speech_snapshot, modelId is the complete voices[].id (including its prefix and voice-pack suffix), while voiceProfileId is a consented voiceProfiles[].id. Do not shorten these IDs. checkMistakes follows the saved human preference when omitted; set true when verified narration is needed. narrationCheck reports passed, matched fraction or unfinished error when Whisper checked the take. A false or missing check is not verified speech: inspect/revise the passage or report the limitation. relativePath is an opaque cache reference. sourceKind must be research, chat, task, or copilot; use task for producer-authored narration. Keep sourceId, passageId, text, and relativePath consistent across synthesis/alignment/export.
export_narration: Use the same native validation, work lock, persistence and cancellation as the desktop. A start action returns acceptance; inspect its job/project for completion. Agent calls must provide a non-existing absolute destinationPath ending in .m4a; WAV is not this exporter format. Set wordTimings to save LRC, VTT, JSON and HTML alongside the audio. Create the parent directory in the approved workspace first if needed.

stage_movie_h3_reference: High-leverage timeline action: stage an @Handle entity (by entityId or '@Handle') or raw assetId over [startSec..endSec] on a non-colliding reference lane (R1..Rn). Tighter timeline spans automatically override wider spans for the same @Handle.
upsert_movie_h3_prompt_section: High-leverage timeline action: create or update a timed [Shot k] prompt section (summaryBeat, detailedAction with @Handle names, cameraAndLighting, soundscapeOverride, musicOverride, vocalEvents <d>[Language] ...</d>, or swapFields) and optional scene globalPrompt without resending the whole scene.
capture_movie_h3_frame_guide: Extract an exact PNG frame at timeSec from a completed take (sourceJobId) or video reference (sourceAssetId) into the Reference Library, optionally pinning it on the scene's Guides track (addGuideAtSec) for FL2V first/last-frame or Ref2V keyframe conditioning.
compile_movie_h3_window: Dry-run the native H3 compiler on a scene window before rendering. Returns exact 17k+5 frame geometry, winner/superseded/capExceeded/belowThreshold/muted/outsideSpan reference verdicts, <Subject>/<Picture>/<Video>/<Audio> bindings, compiled 6-channel prompt text, resolved model + LoRAs, and advisories.
start_movie_h3_generation: Render one or more H3 scene windows in ComfyUI after releasing the local LLM VRAM lease. Defaults to draft02Mp (768x448, expandQualityLadder=false) for fast ~1 min per 2s rendering; pass windows=[] to automatically queue all uncovered prompt sections in order with 23-frame (~0.96s) preContextSec continuity bridging. Only set expandQualityLadder=true (1MP -> 1080p) when slow high-resolution upscaling is explicitly requested.
place_movie_h3_take: Non-destructively place a completed H3 take (jobId) or Reference Library asset (assetId) onto a scene's video (targetVideoLaneId), audio (targetAudioLaneId), or pose/motion driver (targetDriverLaneId) lane using authored_v1 trim geometry (placementMode: trimmed, untrimmed, or assetOnly). Optional gain (0.0-2.0; audio clip gain, or embedded audio gain for video clips) and fadeInSec/fadeOutSec (audio clips) set the mix in the same action, e.g. a quieter A2 score under dialogue.
inspect_movie_h3_take: Inspect a render job's exact compiled prompt, SHA-256 take media path, ridge color-drift report, and native quality telemetry (FFprobe streams, verified boolean, measured audioPeakDbfs/audioMeanDbfs, hasAudio, and 3 extracted contactSheetPaths PNGs).
start_studio_prompt_draft: Ask the selected LOCAL model for an unapplied draft. Read get_app_job with request.requestId, wait for complete, then explicitly save the chosen text. start_producer_task: Delegate a plain-language production request to the selected LOCAL Kestrel model. Only objective is needed. Returns a durable Computer Task; poll get_producer_task_status (compact), inspect paged get_task_history/read_task_record, send replies or new direction with send_producer_message (compact acknowledgement), and stop with stop_computer_task. get_computer_task explicitly reads the full transcript. Workspace access and configured step budget apply. Ordinary chat stays tool-free.
get_producer_task_status: Compact producer task progress, question and artifact paths. Prefer this for polling; get_computer_task returns the full durable transcript for detailed inspection.
get_producer_environment: One compact view of the selected local model, authoritative new-model download destination, library, approved output workspaces, and configured FFmpeg/FFprobe/Strata/ComfyUI/archive paths with filesystem presence. No scans, downloads or model work. Includes effective native generationDefaults; preserve the faster video defaults unless the user asks for higher detail.
export_media_composition: Compose existing native artifacts into a new durable audio-only M4A or silent/soundtrack MP4. Visuals are ordered image holds or trimmed video; transitionSeconds is overlap into that segment. Audio layers can place narration, music, or video sound independently with gain and fades, including sequential songs. No media type is mandatory. Inspect the Rust types. Visual durations minus overlaps must equal durationSeconds; no implicit looping. Sources are IDs or opaque speech cache references, never arbitrary paths. Preserve the returned composition ID for reuse; outputDirectory is an explicit new delivery folder. Nothing is uploaded.
list_media_compositions: List up to 200 recent completed or incomplete native compositions. Discovery never resumes partial work. Completed IDs can be reused as source kind composition.
get_media_composition: Read a completed composition manifest with exact source identities/hashes/FFmpeg arguments, or the saved request for incomplete work.
export_production_bundle: Deliver any selected artifacts and producer-authored text/code as a new folder with a manifest. No output type or platform is required. Artifacts use shared ProductionArtifact handles: image/music takes, movie clips/edits, MiniMax H3 takes (movieH3Take with projectId, jobId and file: video, contactStart, contactMid or contactEnd for continuity stills), speech, compositions, imported attachments, or immutable research HTML/JSON/evidence/provenance. Original copies keep their extensions; jpegImage converts image options to explicit dimensions/fit. filenames are safe relative paths; roles are producer-defined. files contains exact authored text/code, which is saved but never executed. No uploads occur. Discover export_media_composition separately when timing/mixing is needed.
cancel_production_job: Cancel a running composition or bundle using its request.jobId. Partial native artifacts survive; no automatic resume.
list_production_bundles: List up to 200 recent native bundles, including incomplete records, without resuming anything. Complete means native assets were assembled; inspect the action receipt for delivery success.
get_production_bundle: Read a native bundle manifest with file roles/source identities/hashes, or its preserved incomplete request. Use bundle id from the list/export, not jobId.
